lessons.title: Practice Interfaces Union Narrowing
lessons.description: Interfaces describe object shapes, and TypeScript treats a comparison like typeof input === 'number' as a type guard that narrows a union. Keep the exported User interface and implement getId(input: number | User): number: return input directly for numbers, or input.id for User objects. The test checks both union cases.

tests.name: test_get_id
tests.unittest_code:
if (solution.getId(10) !== 10) throw new Error('number case failed');
if (solution.getId({ id: 20, name: 'Bob' }) !== 20) throw new Error('User case failed');
